label: server/store.ts full-file compaction
summary: Owns repository discovery and the complete filesystem persistence lifecycle for projects, DiagramSets, prompts, imported artifacts, generated artifacts, execution records, mappings, highlights, workspaces, and plans.

sections.comment:
StoreFoundation
|
+--> DISCOVER CORPUS
|    +--> function discoverRepository(...)
|    |    +--> const git = async (...)
|    |    `--> resolve worktree root + common Git identity + revision
|    +--> function discoverDocumentCorpus(...)
|    |    `--> realpath -> filesystem-documents identity/binding
|    `--> function discoverDomainCorpus(...)
|         `--> profile -> document or repository discovery
|
+--> IDENTIFY + NORMALIZE
|    +--> function projectIdFor(...) -> SHA-256 identity digest
|    +--> function normalizedProject(...) -> backfill profile + corpus
|    +--> function nowIso(...)
|    +--> function makeId(...)
|    `--> function stableScopedId(...)
|
+--> JSON PERSISTENCE
|    +--> async function readJson(...) -> parse + schema gate
|    +--> async function readJsonIfExists(...) -> ENOENT becomes null
|    `--> async function writeJsonAtomic(...) -> temp file -> rename
|
`--> PATH TOPOLOGY
     +--> constructor(...)
     |    `--> checkoutRoot + storeRoot
     +--> PROJECT PATHS
     |    +--> private projectPath(...) / highlightsPath(...) / spatialProgressPath(...)
     |    `--> private plansRoot(...) / planRoot(...) / planManifestPath(...) / planMarkdownPath(...)
     +--> TEMPLATE + IMPORT PATHS
     |    +--> private systemPromptTemplatesPath(...) / codeEntityPromptTemplatesPath(...)
     |    +--> private importsRoot(...) / importsIndexPath(...)
     |    `--> private importedDiagramPath(...) / importedDiagramComponentPath(...) / importedCodeEntityPath(...) / importedCodeEntityMapPath(...)
     +--> SET ARTIFACT PATHS
     |    +--> private setRoot(...) / setPath(...) / entitiesPath(...)
     |    `--> private diagramPath(...) / diagramComponentPath(...)
     `--> EXECUTION PATHS
          +--> private batchPath(...) / diagramCandidateBatchPath(...)
          +--> private promptConfigPath(...) / codeEntityPromptConfigPath(...)
          `--> private runPath(...) / editSessionPath(...) / codeEntityMapPath(...) / representationGraphPath(...)

ProjectAndImportLifecycle
|
+--> PROJECT OWNERSHIP
|    +--> async ensureProject(...)
|    |    `--> validate corpus identity/domain -> normalize existing or create project
|    +--> async createDiagramSet(...)
|    |    `--> allocate set + entity set -> persist -> attach to project
|    +--> async moveDiagramSetToTrash(...)
|    |    `--> detach project -> rename set root; rollback project on failure
|    `--> async loadProject(...) -> read + normalize
|
`--> GLOBAL IMPORT LIBRARY
     +--> INDEX
     |    +--> async loadImportedArtifactLibrary(...) -> stored or empty index
     |    `--> private async saveImportedArtifactLibrary(...)
     +--> LOAD
     |    +--> async loadImportedDiagram(...) -> backfill view + origin
     |    +--> async loadImportedDiagramComponent(...) -> backfill origin
     |    +--> async loadImportedCodeEntity(...)
     |    `--> async loadImportedCodeEntityMap(...)
     +--> ADD
     |    +--> async addImportedCodeEntity(...) -> conflict check -> file + index
     |    +--> async addImportedCodeEntityMap(...) -> conflict check -> file + index
     |    +--> async addImportedDiagram(...) -> ownership check -> file + index
     |    `--> async addImportedDiagramComponent(...) -> ownership check -> file + index
     `--> MAINTAIN
          +--> async renameImportedDiagram(...)
          +--> async archiveImportedDiagram(...)
          `--> async archiveImportedDiagramComponent(...)

PromptAndArtifactPersistence
|
+--> PROMPT TEMPLATES
|    +--> SYSTEM
|    |    +--> async loadSystemPromptTemplates(...)
|    |    |    +--> const migrateManagedVariables = (...)
|    |    |    `--> normalize named prompts or migrate legacy target dictionaries
|    |    `--> async saveSystemPromptTemplates(...)
|    `--> CODE ENTITY
|         +--> async loadCodeEntityPromptTemplates(...)
|         |    `--> preserve custom templates; migrate source built-in for documents
|         `--> async saveCodeEntityPromptTemplates(...)
|
+--> DIAGRAM SET VIEW
|    +--> async loadDiagramSet(...) -> backfill components/sessions/featured views
|    +--> async setFeaturedView(...) -> update per-view selection
|    `--> async clearFeaturedViewReferences(...) -> scan sets and clear match
|
+--> CORE ARTIFACT LOAD
|    +--> async loadCodeEntities(...) -> backfill origin + stable source-range IDs
|    +--> async loadDiagram(...) -> remove legacy references + backfill origin/view
|    `--> async loadDiagramComponent(...) -> remove legacy references + backfill origin
|
`--> IMMUTABLE PROMPT CONFIGS
     +--> async loadGenerationPromptConfig(...) -> backfill diagram view kind
     +--> async loadCodeEntityPromptConfig(...)
     +--> async saveCodeEntityPromptConfig(...) -> identical replay or reject mutation
     `--> async saveGenerationPromptConfig(...) -> identical replay or reject mutation

ExecutionAndMappingLifecycle
|
+--> GENERATION HISTORY + CANDIDATES
|    +--> private async legacyPromptRepresentation(...) -> reconstruct historical Evidence text
|    +--> async loadGenerationBatch(...)
|    |    `--> normalize current batch or migrate legacy prompt config + outputs
|    +--> private async ensureDiagramCandidateBatch(...) -> materialize stable candidate membership
|    +--> async loadDiagramCandidateBatch(...)
|    `--> async saveDiagramCandidateRankings(...) -> validate complete unique positive ranks
|
+--> ARTIFACT MUTATION
|    +--> async saveDiagramComponent(...)
|    +--> async addDiagram(...) -> file + set membership
|    +--> async addDiagramComponent(...) -> file + set membership
|    +--> async renameDiagram(...)
|    +--> async archiveDiagram(...) -> archive + clear featured reference
|    `--> async archiveDiagramComponent(...)
|
+--> RUN + EDIT + MAP RECORDS
|    +--> async saveRun(...) / loadRun(...) / saveBatch(...)
|    +--> async loadEditSession(...) / saveEditSession(...)
|    `--> async loadCodeEntityMap(...) / saveCodeEntityMap(...)
|
+--> REPRESENTATION + FEEDBACK
|    +--> async loadRepresentationGraph(...) / saveRepresentationGraph(...)
|    +--> async loadHighlights(...) / saveHighlight(...) / deleteHighlight(...)
|    `--> async loadSpatialProgress(...) / saveSpatialProgress(...)
|
+--> ATTACH + COLLECT
|    +--> async addEditSession(...) -> persist + attach session ID
|    +--> async attachRuns(...) / attachRun(...) -> deduplicated run IDs
|    +--> async beginCodeEntityCollection(...) -> pin prompt config + collecting
|    +--> async completeCollection(...) -> finalize entities + ready set
|    `--> async failCollection(...) -> fail mutable entities + set
|
`--> GENERATION COMMIT
     +--> async beginBatch(...)
     |    `--> verify finalized revision/config -> persist runs/batch -> attach IDs
     `--> async completeBatch(...)
          `--> recheck revision -> persist outputs/maps/runs/batch -> update set

MigrationWorkspaceAndPlans
|
+--> LEGACY IMPORT MIGRATION
|    `--> private async migrateLegacyImports(...)
|         +--> load global + per-set artifacts; reserve generated handles
|         +--> const uniqueHandle = (...) -> suffix until unused
|         +--> move imported artifacts to global ownership + unique handles
|         `--> rewrite affected set membership + import index
|
+--> WORKSPACE HYDRATION
|    `--> async loadWorkspace(...)
|         +--[no project]--> global imports + empty project dictionaries
|         `--[project]----> migrate imports -> load sets, entities, configs, batches, runs, maps, graphs, feedback, plans
|
+--> PLAN STORAGE
|    +--> async loadPlan(...) -> manifest + Markdown -> validate
|    +--> async loadPlans(...) -> sorted plan directories -> loadPlan(...)
|    `--> async savePlan(...) -> validate ownership -> atomic Markdown + manifest
|
`--> ID FACTORY
     `--> ids = { set, run, batch, promptConfig, diagram, diagramComponent, codeEntity, sourceRange, editSession, editOperation, highlight, representationFeedback, plan }
          `--> each () => makeId(namespace)
